configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared settings: Ninja generator, build trees under the gitignored .build/ directory (hidden, so gettext does not scan them), compile_commands.json for editors.

configurePresets.name: linux-debug
configurePresets.description: Day-to-day development build. Debug symbols, no optimization.

configurePresets.name: linux-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build, used to catch release-only warnings.

configurePresets.name: linux-asan
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer configuration used by the CI Asan job. Add -DLEAKS=ON to report leaks.

configurePresets.name: linux-coverage
configurePresets.description: Mirrors .github/workflows/coverage.yml. Build the lcov-* targets after running the tests.

configurePresets.name: linux-core
configurePresets.description: WITH_GNUCASH=OFF: libgnucash and its tests without GTK or WebKit. aqbanking and OFX are also disabled because both are importers that live under gnucash/. This is the fastest loop for engine and backend work.

configurePresets.name: macos-debug
configurePresets.description: Requires the dependencies described in README.dependencies.

configurePresets.name: windows-msys2-debug
configurePresets.description: Run from an MSYS2 MINGW64 shell: MINGW64 detection, bash discovery and runtime DLL staging in CMakeLists.txt all depend on that environment. MSVC is not supported until the Qt 6 tier lands; see doc/adr/README.md.
